label: Authentication
instructions: A single failed login is not proof of an attack. Do not invent repetition outside this chunk.

criteria.normal: Successful login, logout, or authorized privilege use.
criteria.warning: Isolated failed authentication or denied access without evidence of abuse.
criteria.error: Authentication service failure or inability to authenticate legitimate users.
criteria.security: Explicit unauthorized access, policy violation, or repeated suspicious authentication attempts evidenced in this chunk.
criteria.other: Insufficient authentication context or unrelated event.
